name: BusinessWith

sources.title: Vendor hub — 'Largest marketplace for SaaS Buyers in Europe'; 'LIST YOUR SAAS' CTA leads to contact-us; no self-serve submission form

requirements: B2B SaaS vendors only — marketplace matching European software buyers to suppliers
No self-serve listing: 'List your SaaS' and 'Get in touch' both route to /contact-us/ — listing happens through a sales conversation
Partner/lead-gen model (testimonials cite 'ROI of around 4x our invested capital' — implies paid engagement)
preparation: SaaS product details, target buyer profile, category positioning
Marketing contact for the vendor conversation
Budget expectation — no free listing path is published
workflow: Open https://hub.businesswith.com/ and click 'LIST YOUR SAAS' / 'GET IN TOUCH'
Submit the contact form (or reach out via /contact-us/)
Discuss listing + lead-gen package with their team
Optionally adopt extras they promote: Review Widget for your own site, LLM Tracker visibility
watchFor: European focus — site network is businesswith.{com,uk,de,dk,es,fi,nl,no,se}; strongest fit for EU/Nordic SaaS
25K+ visitors/month claimed — modest scale vs. large review platforms
No published pricing — expect a sales call before knowing cost
Vendor testimonials are lead-gen oriented, not a neutral directory listing
countsAsLive: A public software profile exists on businesswith.com (or regional site) visible to buyers in category searches
unknowns: Whether any free-tier listing exists behind the sales flow
